Title: Unleash Hell's Fury and other delayed/triggered effects

Messages.Author: lip
Messages.Body:
Hi, I'm looking for some precision on recent ruling  [ANK 20210627] .

So, for clarity:  If the acting player gets blocked by Unleash Hell's Fury, can he play Change of Target before mending the aggravated damage? I guess no, the 2021 ruling is an effective REVERSAL of  [LSJ 2010030] . If acting player bleeds and played Mirror's Walk, defending player blocks with Unleash Hell's Fury, does Unleash still trigger? (I guess yes, from 2021 ruling and Banshee Ironwall example, in line with the reverted 2010 ruling) Follow-up question: If UHF triggers after MW is handled, can Heidelberg's Castle be used to transfer blood before mending UHF aggravated damage (since MW ended the action)? I would have guessed no from the 2021 ruling But then, tricky follow-up: if UHF triggers after MW, can another Methuselah play Minor Boon to prevent the acting vampire to go in torpor? I don't see why not, but then why would you be able to use Minor Boon and not Heidelberg?
If the acting player gets blocked by Unleash Hell's Fury and sent to torpor (no MW this time), can he still play Change of Target to unlock? If the acting player gets blocked by Unleash Hell's Fury while controlling Millicent Smith, does one have priority over the other? Both resolve? Does the acting Methuselah choose the order?
Thanks in advance ☺︎

Unleash Hell's Fury

Change of Target

Banshee Ironwall

Heidelberg's Castle, Germany

Minor Boon

Millicent Smith, Puritan Vampire Hunter

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> lip wrote:
> Hi, I'm looking for some precision on recent ruling  [ANK 20210627] .
>
> So, for clarity:  If the acting player gets blocked by Unleash Hell's Fury, can he play Change of Target before mending the aggravated damage? I guess no, the 2021 ruling is an effective REVERSAL of  [LSJ 2010030] .
>
Not before. UHF inflicts the damage first, since it's a delayed effect (per www.vekn.net/forum/rules-questions/79192-mirror-walk-and-slave?start=12).

> lip wrote:
> If acting player bleeds and played Mirror's Walk, defending player blocks with Unleash Hell's Fury, does Unleash still trigger? (I guess yes, from 2021 ruling and Banshee Ironwall example, in line with the reverted 2010 ruling)
>
Yes, and the damage from UHF needs to be handled.

> lip wrote:
> Follow-up question: If UHF triggers after MW is handled, can Heidelberg's Castle be used to transfer blood before mending UHF aggravated damage (since MW ended the action)? I would have guessed no from the 2021 ruling
>
No, since the action is not over yet (it's "ending" but not "ended" yet). Heidelberg's Castle cannot be used during an action.

> lip wrote:
> But then, tricky follow-up: if UHF triggers after MW, can another Methuselah play Minor Boon to prevent the acting vampire to go in torpor? I don't see why not, but then why would you be able to use Minor Boon and not Heidelberg?
>
Minor Boon can be played during an action.

> lip wrote:
> If the acting player gets blocked by Unleash Hell's Fury and sent to torpor (no MW this time), can he still play Change of Target to unlock?
>
Yes. Being wounded does not prevent from playing action modifiers.

> lip wrote:
> If the acting player gets blocked by Unleash Hell's Fury while controlling Millicent Smith, does one have priority over the other? Both resolve? Does the acting Methuselah choose the order?
>
Both are delayed effects that trigger at the same time. The acting Methuselah can choose in which order to apply them.
